courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 米約高架橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「交變彎矩與導梁的作用」與「支承高程偏差與反力量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；米約高架橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Alternating moments and the role of the nose" and "Support level deviations and reaction measurement" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Millau Viaduct must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以導梁、中心預力、滑移支承與高程控制，讓整條連續梁從橋台後方一段段推過每一座橋墩；米約高架橋則以以高墩、多跨斜張與鋼箱梁頂推，在 270 公尺高的河谷上完成 2,460 公尺連續橋面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on launching nose, centric prestress, sliding bearings and level control that let a continuous girder be pushed segment by segment over every pier from behind the abutment; Millau Viaduct centres on tall piers, multi-span cable stays and a launched steel box deck delivering a 2,460 m continuous deck about 270 m above a valley, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「導梁前端懸臂彎矩」與「橋面風屏」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到米約高架橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「斜索振動、阻尼與監測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Front cantilever moment with nose” and “Deck wind screens”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Millau Viaduct, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Stay vibration, damping and monitoring", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 橋梁頂推施工
history.text: 德國 Leonhardt 與 Baur 的團隊在 1960 年代初建造委內瑞拉 Caroní 河橋，梁體在橋台後組成後頂推越過橋墩，並在每跨設臨時墩、以鋼桁架延伸前端，被 VSL 報告稱為首次具備此工法主要特徵的工程；1965 年奧地利 Kufstein 茵河橋首度採用在橋台後逐段澆製、匹配後整體頂推的真正頂推工法。1970 年代起滑板、導梁與液壓頂推設備標準化，VSL 1977 年的技術報告整理了 30 至 60 m 的經濟跨度與每週一段的循環，20 世紀全球頂推的預力混凝土橋超過 2,500 座。2001 至 2004 年 Millau 高架橋的鋼橋面由谷地兩側以分散式液壓裝置頂推，配合最高約 175 m 的臨時支撐，把工法推向高墩大跨。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: In the early 1960s Leonhardt and Baur's team built the Caroní River bridge in Venezuela, assembling the deck behind the abutment and launching it over the piers with a temporary pier in each span and a steel truss extension at the front, described in a VSL report as the first use of the method's essential features; in 1965 the Inn bridge at Kufstein, Austria, introduced true incremental launching, casting segments behind the abutment, match-casting each against the last and pushing the whole deck forward. From the 1970s sliding pads, noses and hydraulic launching equipment became standard, a 1977 VSL technical report summarised economic spans of 30 to 60 m and a one-segment-per-week cycle, and more than 2,500 prestressed concrete bridges were launched worldwide in the 20th century. Between 2001 and 2004 Millau's steel deck was launched from both sides of the valley by distributed hydraulic devices with temporary supports up to about 175 m tall, extending the method to tall piers and long spans. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
